title: Crane and Tower Operators
description: Operate mechanical boom and cable or tower and cable equipment to lift and move materials, machines, or products in many directions.

tasks.text: Move levers, depress foot pedals, or turn dials to operate cranes, cherry pickers, electromagnets, or other moving equipment for lifting, moving, or placing loads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect crane site conditions to determine ground stability.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical site verification against specs is human

dwas.name: Inspect work sites to determine condition or necessary repairs.
Inspect facilities or sites to determine if they meet specifications or standards.
Inspect buildings or grounds to determine condition.

tasks.text: Inspect and adjust crane mechanisms or lifting accessories to prevent malfunctions or damage.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of moving equipment

dwas.name: Inspect material-moving equipment to detect problems.
Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Direct helpers engaged in placing blocking or outrigging under cranes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material handling direction is on-floor supervision

dwas.name: Direct material handling or moving activities.

tasks.text: Determine load weights and check them against lifting capacities to prevent overload.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Spec verification against references, human confirms edge cases

dwas.name: Weigh materials to ensure compliance with specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, and maintain mechanisms such as cables, pulleys, or grappling devices, making repairs, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machinery cleaning requires hands-on work

dwas.name: Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Inspect cables or grappling devices for wear and install or replace cables, as needed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of moving equipment

dwas.name: Inspect material-moving equipment to detect problems.
Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.

tasks.text: Load or unload bundles from trucks, or move containers to storage bins, using moving equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments

tasks.text: Direct truck drivers backing vehicles into loading bays and cover, uncover, or secure loads for delivery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical hand signals to direct vehicle movement

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate vehicle movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Review daily work or delivery schedules to determine orders, sequences of deliveries, or special loading instructions.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse work orders into procedures reliably

dwas.name: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.

tasks.text: Inspect bundle packaging for conformance to regulations or customer requirements, and remove and batch packaging tickets.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical work inspection against standards

dwas.name: Inspect work to ensure standards are met.
